Title: Frequently asked questions
Subtitle: What you need to know about our AI consulting, models and hosting
Question1: What sets houle apart from other AI providers?
Answer1: We are independent of vendors. We start from your use case and choose the model that fits: Microsoft or OpenAI when relevant, Anthropic or Mistral, or an open-source model hosted in Switzerland when confidentiality, cost or independence matter. We then carry out the integration into your tools, with rules set by your teams and human validation where it is needed.
Question2: Can you build custom AI applications for our specific needs?
Answer2: Yes. Beyond our ready-to-use add-ins, we develop custom solutions: file sorting, document extraction, internal assistants, integrations with your business tools. Depending on the case, they rely on Microsoft 365 and Azure, on other proprietary models or on open-source models hosted in Switzerland. We take projects from pilot to production.
Question3: Is Microsoft 365 compliant with Swiss data protection laws for sensitive professions?
Answer3: Yes. Swiss courts and the Federal Data Protection Commissioner have confirmed that Microsoft 365 can be used in compliance with Swiss data protection law when properly configured. We ensure your setup meets LPD requirements, with data residency in Swiss Azure regions and appropriate technical measures for regulated industries like healthcare, legal, and finance. The United States has been recognized since September 15, 2024 as a state offering an adequate level of protection (for companies that have joined the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework). Switzerland's designation on June 7, 2024 as a state benefiting from the two-tier redress mechanism including access to the Data Protection Review Court (along with the guarantees derived from Executive Order 14086 of October 7, 2022) reduces previously mentioned risks related to data access by U.S. authorities. Transfer of personal data to U.S. companies that have joined the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (or other U.S. companies that have signed Standard Contractual Clauses) is now compliant with the LPD.
Question4: What is the typical ROI timeline for AI implementation?
Answer4: Most clients see measurable productivity gains within 2-3 months. Simple add-ins like email drafting assistants show immediate time savings. Custom workflows and automation projects typically deliver ROI within 6-12 months. We track metrics like time saved per task, error reduction, and process acceleration to quantify impact throughout the project.
Question5: Do your solutions work offline or require constant internet connection?
Answer5: Our Office add-ins require internet connectivity to access AI models, as they communicate with Swiss-hosted GPT servers. However, Microsoft 365 apps themselves work offline, and your documents remain accessible. We design solutions to handle intermittent connectivity gracefully, with clear user feedback when AI features are unavailable.
Question6: How do you handle our proprietary data and business secrets?
Answer6: Data sovereignty is core to our offering. Your content stays in Swiss data centers, conversations are encrypted in transit and at rest, and we operate under Swiss jurisdiction. Zero-retention policies mean your data is never used for model training. Administrators control exactly what information can be processed by AI and what remains isolated.
Question7: Can we use our own Azure subscription instead of yours?
Answer7: Yes. You can host everything in your own Azure tenant, or use our infrastructure hosted in Switzerland for a faster setup. For open-source models, deployment can also be done on your own servers or with a Swiss host of your choice. In every case, your IT team keeps visibility over resources, costs and data flows.
Answer8: Ready-to-use add-ins can be deployed within days. Custom solutions vary by scope: simple Power Automate workflows take 2-4 weeks, while complex SPFx applications with Azure backend integration require 2-4 months. We provide detailed timelines during the scoping phase and use agile methodologies to deliver value incrementally.
Question9: Do you provide training for our employees?
Answer9: Yes, comprehensive training is included. We offer both end-user sessions on how to use the AI tools effectively and administrator training for managing configurations and permissions. Documentation is provided in French, German, and English. For custom solutions, we also train your internal developers to maintain and extend the systems we build.
Question10: What happens if the AI generates incorrect information?
Answer10: AI models can make mistakes, which is why we design solutions with appropriate safeguards. Critical workflows include human review steps. We implement confidence scoring, source citation, and validation checkpoints. For sensitive domains like legal or financial content, we recommend AI as an assistant to experts rather than a replacement, with final decisions always made by qualified professionals.
Question11: Can we integrate with non-Microsoft systems?
Answer11: Yes. Our solutions connect to third-party systems through APIs, webhooks and data connectors: ERP, CRM, accounting software, business tools. In a Microsoft environment, Azure Logic Apps provides many ready-made connectors; elsewhere, we develop the connectors needed.
Answer12: Our solutions support multiple languages out of the box. The AI models we use handle French, German, Italian, English, and other languages fluently. Swiss multilingual businesses particularly benefit from this, as the same tool can serve teams working in different languages without requiring separate deployments or configurations.
Question13: How do you handle updates and new AI model versions?
Answer13: For our managed solutions, we follow new model versions and test them on your cases before putting them into service. For deployments in your own environment, whether an Azure tenant or a self-hosted open-source model, you decide the timing: a version does not change without your agreement, and we carry out updates in planned maintenance windows.

Question17: Are your solutions compatible with government and public sector requirements?

Question19: How does houle compare to Microsoft Copilot?
Answer19: Copilot is the assistant built into Microsoft 365. For many office uses it is a good choice, and we help deploy it properly. We step in where Copilot is not enough: specific business processes, decision rules particular to your organisation, data that must stay on infrastructure hosted in Switzerland, or integration with non-Microsoft tools. Question20: Can employees use ChatGPT or Claude safely with company data?
Answer20: Public AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude pose data sovereignty risks when employees paste confidential information. Most organizations ban or restrict these tools due to data leakage concerns. Our Swiss GPT platform provides similar capabilities within your controlled environment. Employees get powerful AI assistance without uploading sensitive data to external services. You set boundaries on what can be processed and maintain audit trails.
Question21: How does the EU AI Act affect our use of AI?
Answer21: The EU AI Act classifies workplace AI systems by risk level, requiring transparency and human oversight for high-risk applications. While Switzerland isn't EU, many Swiss companies must comply due to European operations. Our solutions help you meet these requirements with configurable oversight, audit logs, and clear AI boundaries. We document AI decision points and maintain compliance records for regulatory assessments.
Question22: What about professional secrecy for lawyers and other regulated professions?
Answer22: The Swiss Bar Association (FSA) confirms that cloud services can be used by lawyers when proper safeguards are in place. The FSA recommends informing clients in mandate contracts about cloud service usage for transparency and consent documentation. Microsoft offers tailored contracts for sensitive professions addressing specific confidentiality obligations. We help configure Microsoft 365 to meet professional secrecy requirements, implement client notification procedures, and ensure Swiss data residency for attorney-client privileged communications.
Question23: Which AI models do you work with?
Answer23: With several families: OpenAI models (including through Azure OpenAI), those from Anthropic and Mistral, and open-source models such as Llama, Mistral, Qwen or Gemma. We have no exclusivity with any vendor. For each project, we test two or three models on a sample of your documents and recommend the one that offers the best compromise between quality, cost and constraints on your data.
Question24: What does "hosted in Switzerland" mean in practice?
Answer24: For each project, we set four points in writing: where the model runs (machines located in Switzerland, either yours or those of a Swiss host), where the data is stored (documents, indexes and results on that same infrastructure), who has access (a restricted list of named people) and what is logged (decisions and accesses, without keeping more content than necessary). With a self-hosted open-source model, the texts processed are not sent to the model's vendor. This does not replace your own legal analysis, but it simplifies it.
Question25: When is an open-source model hosted in Switzerland preferable to a US AI subscription?
Answer25: Mainly in four situations: your data is covered by professional or medical secrecy; the task is repetitive and well defined, such as sorting or extraction; your volumes make pay-per-use billing expensive; or you do not want to depend on a single supplier. Conversely, for varied uses, small volumes or a team without operations skills, a managed service is often simpler. We detail this choice in the decision guide published in our resources.
